text_blocks.snippet: Losartan is generally well-tolerated, but it can cause mild to serious side effects. Most common side effects improve as your body adjusts to the medication.

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up quickly)
Cold-like symptoms (stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, or sinus pressure)
Severe allergic reaction (angioedema): Sudden swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or trouble breathing.
Severely low blood pressure: Extreme dizziness, fainting, or blurry vision.
Kidney problems: Little to no urination, swelling in your ankles, hands, or feet, or unexplained weight gain.
High potassium levels (hyperkalemia): Muscle weakness, slow or irregular heartbeat, or feeling faint.
Liver issues: Yellowing of your skin or eyes (jaundice) or severe upper stomach pain.

text_blocks.snippet: You can learn more about managing your prescription details on the Mayo Clinic Losartan Guide or review general safety tips via GoodRx Losartan Information.
